snippet.title: SUPER AC - CINESCAPE VR Release Trailer
snippet.description:
CINESCAPE VR is now available on Meta Quest Store!
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/cinescape-vr/9089051267851590/

- 3 unique environments with more than 50 puzzles to solve and have fun!
- Fully hand tracking! No need to fight with the gamepad.
- Use the special Cinemorphosys power to transform object!

#cinescapevr #superacgames #metaquest3 #escapegames
